text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When people hear "Agnes Tachyon," they 
think of the academy's problem child... 
Naturally... I wasn't thrilled about 
sharing a space with her...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That said, I needed a place to store my 
merchandise... 
So I ended up reluctantly accepting the 
arrangement... That's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ghh! It's no use! 
It seems our only option is to kick down 
the door!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I would rather not subject my 
legs to unnecessary impact— 
Wait, then how about we just blow it up!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Blow it up, you say...? 
That's, ...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I wanted explosion to be a last resort... 
so I tried all sorts of things, but the 
door was sturdy... 
In the end... we managed to get outside by 
blowing it up, just like she said...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"*cough*, *hack hack*!! ...We did it, we 
did it! 
We can finally get out! Having to write an 
apology letter and pay for damages is a 
pain, but it can't be helped!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Relieved... I looked out the window and 
saw the night sky turning into the dim 
light of dawn... 
And then... it hit me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Um... it might be a bit late to mention 
this, but... 
If we had just waited until morning, 
wouldn't someone have opened it for 
us...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...............Ah, ...Aaah~ ...You've got 
to be kidding me. 
Right, you're right, of course that's 
true...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Agnes Tachyon holding her head 
in her hands like an ordinary person... 
It was so strange and amusing. It left a 
lasting impression on me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even now, for some reason, I still recall 
it from time to time... That smoky morning 
hallway... 
And her soot-covered figure, holding her 
head and giving a defeated laugh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Such things happened...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And other things, too. Like seeing 
Yukino-san walking down the hallway with a 
tiny snowman, 
or Pokke-san getting into a huge fight 
with her teammates...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The members of the Victory Club laying out 
a picnic sheet in the courtyard in 
spring... 
Universe-san, all alone, reaching her hand 
up toward the clear sky...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Memories like that can lift me up when 
I'm feeling down... 
It's very rare, but it definitely 
happens...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a major success, nor a 
life-changing experience... 
Just "special moments that simply 
existed"—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They can kindle a flame in one's heart... 
And certainly become a "grain of gold" in 
the distant future, I believe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not good at group life either... 
...I'd rather be alone in a dark, quiet 
place whenever possible...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
However, I feel that if you don't pay 
attention, those moments will just... 
pass you by...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............I'm sorry if that sounded 
meddlesome. 
...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Things that just pass you by if you don't 
pay attention. 
...Come to think of it, back then, Air 
Groove said—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That's precisely why I want you to step 
into the center of this life. 
I want you to face it head-on, without 
pulling away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Within it, there are things you will 
surely come to see. 
Things that will be of benefit to you. 
...That, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...I hated the summer camp. It felt so 
stifling, so annoying—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Yet, I wonder when it changed. Those 
feelings softened... 
And this evening was truly fun.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Could it be... is the reason for that—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to join in, Cafe? If you 
don't like sparklers, we've got other 
stuff. 
Look, ground blooms, bottle rockets, 
ground spinners, firecrackers—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Could we please... put the firecrackers 
away...? 
There are two people here who might do 
anything with them...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pokke-kun. Apparently, the original 
sparklers were made by attaching gunpowder 
to thin straw. 
...Wouldn't you like to see the beauty 
that captivated people 300 years ago?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oi, you're gonna drop your spark! Focus on 
the match!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ("Special moments that simply existed.")

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Is... right now one of them? 
Is this scenery... something precious I'll 
remember one day?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Something that will give me a push 
forward someday?)

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start preparing for the 
bingo tournament soon. 
Regarding the MC on the day and shopping 
for prizes—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was thinking that maybe something 
even more special... 
would be better...

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Umm, what do you mean by special...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Something more, well... like a 
recreational activity that will stay in 
everyone's memories, 
in the depths of their hearts. I feel like 
that would be better.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Since we went through the trouble of 
coming to summer training camp and all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Hooo, ho, ho, ho, ho!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That Suzuka-kun! Asking to reconsider the 
recreation event! 
And reworking the plan from scratch! Well, 
well, how truly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I just thought that would be better for 
everyone. 
But... I have no idea what we should 
actually do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you're trying to survey us, 
I take it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
What kind of event would make all of you 
happy?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be best to just blow off some 
steam and have a blast? 
Everyone's been training nonstop, so we 
need to let it all out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho? I'd prefer to just devote myself to 
observing all of you. 
Slowly, and thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of recreation... watermelon 
splitting and beach volleyball, perhaps? 
Either way, something easy to supervise 
would help. What about you, Cafe?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Umm... I prefer relaxing, personally... 
Brewing coffee, gazing at the scenery..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you. They're all good ideas, but 
everyone wants something different... 
Finding something that every single person 
can enjoy is—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah!
